value.rationale: The canonical cuboctahedral 4-regular ice ensemble is a natural symmetric finite test case. Its complete recoverable Fourier rank, first non-forced quartic blind modes (864/21 full-symmetry orbits), and exact best-possible endpoint projection norm describe nontrivial information loss and reconstruction amplification. This is not derivable from the already-known unsigned count or from lower-degree covariance alone; a complete finite canonical invariant has direct reuse in harmonic recovery studies.
